text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Air Groove conquers the Shuka Sho! It's 
Air Groove! With this—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove achieves the Triple Tiara!! The 
flawless "Empress" is born right here, 
right now--!!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
A-Awesome! I'm so glad I came to watch~! 
Air Groove, congrats!! You're the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, ugh, *waaaaah*! You were 
incredible, Air Groove! I'm so moved~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Empress! Empress! Empress! Empress!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A deafening roar for the Empress fills 
Kyoto Racecourse! Today, we have become 
witnesses to history! Congratulations, Air 
Groove! Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...We managed to accomplish one thing, at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I told you, didn't I? That I would surely 
reward your efforts.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You did a fine job as well. ...Once again, 
you have my thanks.

With the roar of the crowd behind me, on 
the way back to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your hard work at the Shuka 
Sho! Um, I just really wanted to talk to 
you, so I couldn't help myself..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been watching you challenge the 
Triple Tiara this whole time, senpai, and, 
well—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-senpai is... my ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much... for becoming my 
ideal."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, I'm going to chase after 
you, Senpai. Chase you, and chase you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Someday... I will surpass you, Senpai!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —I like that spirit.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure you catch up to me. I'll be 
looking forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, congratulations on today! 
And—thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. That's a good look on your face.
choice_data_list: So you kept your promise, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're right. ...However, this is no time 
to be complacent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ideals must remain ideals. For the sake of 
all Umamusume from here on—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to challenge myself and 
aim for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now that's my trainer.
